spec_match.rationale: Real click on a target="_current" link next to a frame genuinely named _current, with a sidecar control — directly observes the removal.

interactive.rationale: Both click buttons navigated the expected frame and updated the frame-state table; Reset restored it.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The core behavioural proof the index promises.

edge_cases.rationale: Control target distinguishes a broken harness from the behaviour change.

references.rationale: No chromestatus.com/feature/5121089536262144 link on the concept page (invariant #3); only the feature index has it.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 4/4 PASS on reflection/name/targetable-element contracts; the behavioural removal itself is proven by the which-frame-actually-moved harness rather than the suite.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): _current landed in the sibling frame; console clean; 2 telemetry 400s; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: Telemetry loads, but navigating harness frames aborts their in-flight beacons: POST /telemetry/demo returned 400 ("Cannot read request body") 1-2 times per run.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Add the chromestatus.com/feature/5121089536262144 link
openQuestions.detail: None of the three concept pages links the ChromeStatus entry (only the feature index does). Invariant #3 requires every page to carry it — it is the slug self-heal key.

openQuestions.title: Stop frame navigations producing 400 telemetry beacons
openQuestions.detail: nav-frame.html / nav-source.html each load the telemetry client; when the harness navigates them mid-batch the beacon body is torn down and the server logs BadResource + 400. Skip telemetry inside the harness frames (they are fixtures) or make the endpoint tolerate truncated bodies.

guidanceConsulted.query: iframe navigation target and link accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give iframes accessible titles, keep native buttons/links, and announce results textually.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Observed: harness frames are titled and the result is restated as text in a status region and a frame-state table; iframe focus stops have no visible ring (browser default for frames).
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "iframe navigation target and link accessibility" (run 2026-11-15)

summary: Critique-only pass. Loaded http://localhost:3109/v153/remove-non-standard-navigations-targeted-at-current/which-frame-actually-moved/ in Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass), clicked/changed every visible control, captured console errors and failed requests, checked 360px horizontal overflow and a Tab focus walk, and ran /v153/remove-non-standard-navigations-targeted-at-current/conformance/ (unflagged, and with the relevant --enable-blink-features flag where one exists). Non-minor work items are listed in openQuestions.
